title: Log in, then authenticate later calls
prompt: Create `src/session.ts` that exports `async function signIn(client: Client<paths>, username: string, password: string): Promise<void>`. It calls `POST /auth/login`, then registers a middleware on the same client so that every later request carries `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. When the login fails (for example 401), it throws an `Error` and registers nothing.
